mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article (title, category_id, cover_image, author_id, status, create_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{categoryId}, #{coverImage}, #{authorId}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET status = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE article SET title = #{title}, category_id = #{categoryId}, cover_image = #{coverImage}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, c.name as category_name, c.category_alias, u.username as author_name FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN user u ON a.author_id = u.id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id
